header_semantics.canonical_export_order: field index order; v1.1 appends customer_email after all legacy v1 fields

compatibility.change_policy: v1.1 is additive: the legacy 82 v1 fields remain unchanged and customer_email is appended as OPTIONAL. Consumers must select by contract version/header set; receipts bind exact version and digest.

source_basis.name: 2026-08-27 dual-skill patch tickets: voice-ready audit context, analysis-send fallback, optional customer_email

fields.name: phone_number
fields.description: Official ElevenLabs batch upload destination-number transport column; use E.164 format.
fields.notes: Current ElevenLabs docs require this exact header for dashboard CSV/XLS upload.

fields.name: recipient_number
fields.description: Pixelkiez mirror of phone_number for the shared data contract; must match when populated.
fields.notes: Keep identical to phone_number. ElevenLabs currently uses phone_number for dialing.

fields.name: campaign_id
fields.description: Stable outbound campaign identifier.

fields.name: lead_id
fields.description: Stable lead identifier for traceability; never use auth secrets.
fields.notes: Do not use secret/internal auth tokens.

fields.name: customer_name
fields.description: Verified human contact name; blank if unknown.
fields.notes: Never invent a person name from the restaurant name.

fields.name: customer_salutation
fields.description: Verified salutation or preferred form of address; blank if unknown.
fields.notes: Leave blank if not verified.

fields.name: customer_website
fields.description: Prospect website URL associated with the audit.

fields.name: website_language
fields.description: Observed primary website language; not automatically the person spoken-language preference.
fields.notes: Observation about website; not automatically the person's preferred spoken language.

fields.name: customer_language
fields.description: Approved language the agent should use for the call.
fields.notes: Use a known/approved language or campaign default.

fields.name: customer_locale
fields.description: Locale for wording and date conventions.

fields.name: restaurant_name
fields.description: Official/display name of the restaurant or business; for cross-industry use this carries the business display name.

fields.name: customer_role
fields.description: Verified role of the contacted person if known.
fields.notes: Leave blank if unknown.

fields.name: city
fields.description: Prospect city if known.

fields.name: district
fields.description: Prospect district/neighbourhood if known.

fields.name: restaurant_category
fields.description: Business category when reliably known; blank when not applicable or unknown.

fields.name: cuisine_type
fields.description: Cuisine only when reliably known; blank for non-gastronomy prospects.
fields.notes: Do not infer from names alone.

fields.name: prospect_company
fields.description: Compatibility alias for the prospect business name.
fields.notes: Set equal to restaurant_name.

fields.name: prospect_role
fields.description: Compatibility alias for customer_role.
fields.notes: Set equal to customer_role when known.

fields.name: prospect_locale
fields.description: Compatibility alias for customer_locale.
fields.notes: Set equal to customer_locale.

fields.name: website_role
fields.description: Campaign-controlled description of the website business role; not a measured site fact.
fields.example: Auffindbarkeit, Speisekarte, Kontakt und direkter Reservierungsweg
fields.notes: Campaign-controlled context, not a measured fact about a specific restaurant.

fields.name: primary_customer_type
fields.description: Customer/business context used by conversation policy.

fields.name: lead_source_current
fields.description: Externally governed lead-source reference.
fields.notes: Must be externally governed.

fields.name: compliance_status
fields.description: Externally supplied call-eligibility status; the CSV value does not self-authorize calling.
fields.notes: Allowed values per skill: APPROVED, BLOCKED, LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED. Only APPROVED rows may proceed to live calling.

fields.name: do_not_contact
fields.description: Do-not-contact suppression state.
fields.notes: If true, the row must not be called.

fields.name: jurisdiction
fields.description: Jurisdiction for the campaign or lead.

fields.name: contact_type
fields.description: Contact type for the campaign.
fields.notes: Current campaign contract is B2B.

fields.name: ai_disclosure_required
fields.description: Whether campaign policy requires explicit AI disclosure.
fields.notes: Pixelkiez architecture adopts explicit AI disclosure.

fields.name: recording_status
fields.description: Externally governed recording approval status.
fields.notes: Use OFF, APPROVED, or LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED according to external approval.

fields.name: audit_id
fields.description: Identifier of the validated website audit packet.

fields.name: audit_date
fields.description: Audit date in ISO 8601 date form.

fields.name: audit_method_scope
fields.description: Bounded semicolon-separated description of what was actually checked.
fields.notes: Do not imply analytics/ranking checks that were not performed.

fields.name: audit_overall_score
fields.description: Overall score only when an approved score method was used.
fields.notes: Leave blank if score method not approved/not used.

fields.name: audit_score_scale
fields.description: Scale for an approved overall score.
fields.notes: Leave blank if no approved score.

fields.name: audit_score_status
fields.description: Status of the score method; prevents draft/not-used scores being presented as approved.
fields.notes: Use approved contract values, e.g. APPROVED_INTERNAL / NOT_USED.

fields.name: audit_limitations
fields.description: Concise audit limitations that constrain spoken claims.
fields.example: Keine Analytics; keine Search Console; keine Conversiondaten
fields.notes: Important guardrail against overclaiming.

fields.name: audit_strength_1_observation
fields.description: One positive verified audit observation when useful.
fields.example: Oeffnungszeiten und Adresse sind direkt sichtbar.

fields.name: audit_strength_1_evidence_pointer
fields.description: Evidence pointer for the positive observation.

fields.name: audit_strength_1_confidence
fields.description: Confidence 0..1 for the positive observation.

fields.name: audit_hook_1_id
fields.description: Finding identifier for audit hook 1.

fields.name: audit_hook_1_dimension
fields.description: Dimension/category of audit hook 1.

fields.name: audit_hook_1_priority
fields.description: Priority of audit hook 1.

fields.name: audit_hook_1_evidence_class
fields.description: Evidence class for audit hook 1; UNKNOWN is never spoken as a claim.
fields.notes: Allowed: VERIFIED_FACT, SUPPORTED_INFERENCE, HYPOTHESIS, UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN must never be spoken as a claim.

fields.name: audit_hook_1_observation
fields.description: Exact bounded observation for audit hook 1; grounded in the validated audit packet.
fields.example: Reservierungsweg ist im ersten sichtbaren Bereich nicht direkt erkennbar.
fields.notes: Must be grounded in the validated audit packet.

fields.name: audit_hook_1_evidence_pointer
fields.description: Evidence pointer for audit hook 1.

fields.name: audit_hook_1_confidence
fields.description: Confidence 0..1 for audit hook 1.

fields.name: audit_hook_1_spoken
fields.description: Pre-approved spoken wording for audit hook 1; preferred over improvising from raw evidence.
fields.example: Bei unserem Website-Check ist uns aufgefallen, dass der Reservierungsweg nicht direkt sichtbar ist. Ist das fuer Sie relevant?
fields.notes: Preferred field for the agent to verbalize; avoids improvising unsupported claims.

fields.name: audit_hook_1_possible_relevance
fields.description: Cautious possible relevance for audit hook 1; never a guaranteed impact claim.
fields.example: Direkte Reservierungswege koennen relevant sein, wenn eigene Reservierungen fuer den Betrieb wichtig sind.
fields.notes: Must not be phrased as guaranteed business impact.

fields.name: audit_hook_1_prohibited_claims
fields.description: Pipe-separated claims that must never be spoken for audit hook 1.
fields.example: Dadurch verlieren Sie Reservierungen|Das kostet Sie Umsatz
fields.notes: Use | as separator inside one CSV cell.

fields.name: audit_hook_1_selector_score
fields.description: Internal selector score for audit hook 1; not a customer-facing website score.
fields.notes: Internal ranking aid; not a customer-facing website score.

fields.name: audit_hook_2_id
fields.description: Finding identifier for audit hook 2.

fields.name: audit_hook_2_dimension
fields.description: Dimension/category of audit hook 2.

fields.name: audit_hook_2_priority
fields.description: Priority of audit hook 2.

fields.name: audit_hook_2_evidence_class
fields.description: Evidence class for audit hook 2; UNKNOWN is never spoken as a claim.
fields.notes: Allowed: VERIFIED_FACT, SUPPORTED_INFERENCE, HYPOTHESIS, UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN must never be spoken as a claim.

fields.name: audit_hook_2_observation
fields.description: Exact bounded observation for audit hook 2; grounded in the validated audit packet.
fields.example: Speisekarte ist nur als PDF verlinkt.
fields.notes: Must be grounded in the validated audit packet.

fields.name: audit_hook_2_evidence_pointer
fields.description: Evidence pointer for audit hook 2.

fields.name: audit_hook_2_confidence
fields.description: Confidence 0..1 for audit hook 2.

fields.name: audit_hook_2_spoken
fields.description: Pre-approved spoken wording for audit hook 2; preferred over improvising from raw evidence.
fields.example: Ein zweiter Punkt betrifft die Speisekarte: Sie ist in unserem Check nur als PDF verlinkt. Waere eine direkt lesbare Web-Speisekarte fuer Sie relevant?
fields.notes: Preferred field for the agent to verbalize; avoids improvising unsupported claims.

fields.name: audit_hook_2_possible_relevance
fields.description: Cautious possible relevance for audit hook 2; never a guaranteed impact claim.
fields.example: Direkt lesbare Menues koennen fuer mobile Nutzung und maschinelle Lesbarkeit relevant sein.
fields.notes: Must not be phrased as guaranteed business impact.

fields.name: audit_hook_2_prohibited_claims
fields.description: Pipe-separated claims that must never be spoken for audit hook 2.
fields.example: Google kann Ihr PDF nicht lesen|Sie ranken deshalb schlechter
fields.notes: Use | as separator inside one CSV cell.

fields.name: audit_hook_2_selector_score
fields.description: Internal selector score for audit hook 2; not a customer-facing website score.
fields.notes: Internal ranking aid; not a customer-facing website score.

fields.name: audit_hook_3_id
fields.description: Finding identifier for audit hook 3.
fields.notes: Hook 1 primary; hook 2 optional; hook 3 only for genuine prospect demand.

fields.name: audit_hook_3_dimension
fields.description: Dimension/category of audit hook 3.

fields.name: audit_hook_3_priority
fields.description: Priority of audit hook 3.

fields.name: audit_hook_3_evidence_class
fields.description: Evidence class for audit hook 3; UNKNOWN is never spoken as a claim.
fields.notes: Allowed: VERIFIED_FACT, SUPPORTED_INFERENCE, HYPOTHESIS, UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN must never be spoken as a claim.

fields.name: audit_hook_3_observation
fields.description: Exact bounded observation for audit hook 3; grounded in the validated audit packet.
fields.notes: Must be grounded in the validated audit packet.

fields.name: audit_hook_3_evidence_pointer
fields.description: Evidence pointer for audit hook 3.

fields.name: audit_hook_3_confidence
fields.description: Confidence 0..1 for audit hook 3.

fields.name: audit_hook_3_spoken
fields.description: Pre-approved spoken wording for audit hook 3; preferred over improvising from raw evidence.
fields.example: Wir haben die lokale Sichtbarkeit nicht belastbar gemessen. Waere das grundsaetzlich ein Thema fuer Sie?
fields.notes: Preferred field for the agent to verbalize; avoids improvising unsupported claims.

fields.name: audit_hook_3_possible_relevance
fields.description: Cautious possible relevance for audit hook 3; never a guaranteed impact claim.
fields.example: Lokale Auffindbarkeit kann fuer Restaurants relevant sein, wurde hier aber nicht gemessen.
fields.notes: Must not be phrased as guaranteed business impact.

fields.name: audit_hook_3_prohibited_claims
fields.description: Pipe-separated claims that must never be spoken for audit hook 3.
fields.example: Sie werden bei Google schlecht gefunden|ChatGPT empfiehlt Ihre Konkurrenz
fields.notes: Use | as separator inside one CSV cell.

fields.name: audit_hook_3_selector_score
fields.description: Internal selector score for audit hook 3; not a customer-facing website score.
fields.notes: Internal ranking aid; not a customer-facing website score.

fields.name: call_stage
fields.description: Initial or current call state-machine stage.
fields.notes: Can be updated by ElevenLabs Update State tool.

fields.name: interest_level
fields.description: Current interest-state value.
fields.notes: Update during conversation.

fields.name: confirmed_relevance
fields.description: Whether the prospect has confirmed relevance of the discussed topic.
fields.notes: Update during conversation.

fields.name: meeting_readiness
fields.description: Current meeting-readiness state; never derive from turn count alone.
fields.notes: Do not derive from turn count.

fields.name: preferred_followup_time
fields.description: Known preferred callback/follow-up time; blank if unknown.
fields.notes: Usually blank initially; may be set in-call.

fields.name: opt_out
fields.description: Conversation opt-out state; set immediately when applicable.
fields.notes: Set true immediately after hard no/do-not-call.

fields.name: needs_human
fields.description: Whether human follow-up or escalation is needed.
fields.notes: Update during conversation.

fields.name: meeting_offer
fields.description: Approved label for the human consultation/handoff offer.
fields.notes: Do not promise a booked meeting without tool success.

fields.name: meeting_timezone
fields.description: Timezone for meeting references.

fields.name: consultant_id
fields.description: Approved consultant/resource identifier if available.
fields.notes: Leave blank until approved.

fields.name: meeting_duration_minutes
fields.description: Approved meeting duration if available.
fields.notes: Leave blank until approved.

fields.name: customer_email
fields.description: Optional prospect email address for confirming the destination after the analysis-send fallback is accepted.
fields.missing_semantics: Blank means unknown or not supplied. Never infer from a domain or company name; ask only after the prospect accepts the analysis-send fallback.
fields.source: CRM or verified prospect contact; never inferred from website/domain
fields.notes: Optional. Confirm once if present after fallback acceptance; otherwise ask. A corrected address is runtime handoff data and does not mutate the source CSV.
